title: ContributorPresence Frontmatter Schema — operational source of truth for the observation model; notarized projection target is the contributor_presences DHT entry type in imagodei DNA
description: Operational IoC contract (Category C) for presence frontmatter in genesis/data/presences/*.md. Presences are observation-graph nodes representing cited contributors (authors, organizations, speakers) who may later claim their own agent-scoped identity. This schema is a projection of the notarized ContributorPresence entry type; the DNA entry is the authority for core identity fields, and this schema adds seed-data vocabulary that rides on metadata_json at the Rust boundary. Reconstruction strategy: rebuild from Rust ContributorPresence struct + design doc genesis/plans/2026-04-11-humans-schema-design.md.

id.description: Unique slug. Must match filename stem.

observations.description: Observation edges. Each observation is a witnessing act by a registered human; at least one is required at genesis.

primaryStewardId.description: Current steward's human id. Defaults to observations[0].observerId if unset. Cross-reference validated by companion script.

sameAsPresenceIds.description: Known duplicate presences. Empty at genesis; populated by future merge work.

items.description: Soft hint for the claim flow — which collectives this presence is likely affiliated with. Cross-reference validated by companion script.

tags.description: Free-form thematic tags. Currently populated by the one-shot Consilience Garden migration (section names slugified). Future sprints may introduce a tag vocabulary but this field stays free-form at the schema layer.

local.description: Path to local webp image, relative to the presences/ directory.

placeholder.description: True when the image is a stub awaiting a real upload.

Observation.description: A witnessing act by a registered human that brings this presence into the observation graph.

observerId.description: Human id of the observer. Must reference a human in genesis/data/humans/. Cross-reference validated by companion script.

observedAt.description: UTC timestamp of the observation moment — when the observer first took note of this presence and created the recognition record. This is the anchor for the value-flow graph: each observation with a contextContentId can eventually trigger a flow event back to the observer when the cited content accumulates recognition.

context.description: Free-form context for the observation (how/where the observer encountered this presence).

contextContentId.description: Optional content node id tying the observation to a specific ContentNode. Cross-reference validated by companion script when non-null.

ExternalIdentifier.description: External handle or canonical identifier for this presence (ORCID, Wikipedia, social, etc.).

type.description: Ordered by semantic weight for claim verification: canonical research identifiers first (orcid, isni, wikipedia, wikidata) — strongest signal; social identities (linkedin, twitter, mastodon, personal-domain) — medium signal; direct-work identifiers (doi, isbn, arxiv, github) — strong when present; contact (homepage, email) — weakest. New entries should be inserted in the appropriate tier.

Work.description: A work attributed to this presence (book, paper, talk, project, etc.).

items.description: Content node id where this work is cited. Cross-reference validated by companion script.
